articles.summary: Midlothian, TX., November 2, 2026 –Ennis, Inc. (the “Company”), (NYSE: EBF) today announced that it has acquired Telemark Diversified Graphics, a thermal paper products manufacturer located in Sturgis, Michigan. articles.title: Ennis Acquires Telemark Diversified Graphics, Expands Thermal Paper Business
